analysis: The three changed files are test-only and make mechanical API-adaptation edits for an upstream MLXLMCommon change. The stub LanguageModel.prepare signature in WeightHashCacheEligibilityTests.swift:10 and EngineV2VisionRoutingTests.swift:129 now takes (state:, prefill:) in place of windowSize. DiffusionToolResultMediaTests.swift:40 now reads `image.source` instead of matching on the enum directly. No production source, key handling, attestation, coordinator protocol, cache storage or authorization logic changed. The stubs still return .tokens(input.text), newCache still returns [], and they are never forward-passed. The test assertions are unchanged. Those assertions cover the weight-hash fresh-bracket publish/abort behavior relevant to T-041 and the SSD cache weight-hash binding, and the tool-result media ordering and role refusal. Nothing here weakens those tests. One limit: the diff does not show the production code or the dependency bump that motivated the signature change. The `prefill`/`state` semantics and the `UserInput.Image.source` behavior in the upstream MLXLMCommon dependency therefore sit outside the evidence. If the dependency was bumped in the same PR, that package-resolution change should be reviewed separately for supply-chain concerns. No regression or new attack surface was identified in the supplied units. The EngineV2VisionRoutingTests.swift base text was truncated at line 679, but the only change is at line 129.
